title: Evidence packets
summary: A Markdown file and a JSON file for citing findings: each claim with its basis, sources, quoted excerpts, the detector's own account, confidence and what it does not show, plus a content hash.

paragraphs: In the Findings inbox, open Export a verifiable report, then Export evidence packet for the list, or expand one finding and use Export evidence packet there. The app writes two files into its report folder: a Markdown file to read and cite, and a JSON file with the same content.

sections.heading: What each claim carries
items: Its basis, stated in words: a counted violation (a counted comparison against a rule or commitment the record states) or a pattern signal (evidence for review, not a legal conclusion).
The detector's name and the detector's own account of what it compared or counted.
The confidence as observed: a measured percentage, or Not assessed, which is not a score of zero.

Each source document: file name, file and extracted-text digests, download address and character range where recorded, and the quoted excerpt with whether it was checked against stored text. Anything not recorded says so.
What this does not show, built from what was actually observed for that claim.

sections.heading: Gaps are not findings
paragraphs: Routes the app identified but could not test are listed in their own section, only for the detectors behind the claims. A gap has no basis and no confidence, and is never counted as a claim. An empty gap list does not mean none exist, and a failed gap check is stated in the limitations.

sections.heading: Regenerating and comparing
paragraphs: The content hash is the SHA-256 of the packet's content. It does not change when the packet is regenerated from unchanged findings, whatever the time or order, and it changes when a quote, a confidence, a claim or a gap changes. The packet is not signed, so the hash shows a change but not who made the packet. Detectors are identified by name only; no detector version is recorded, and a different program build can produce different content.

sections.heading: What is left out
paragraphs: Guesses about who a redaction hides and dismissed findings are never included. Excerpts, names and addresses from documents that are not public are not included. Download addresses lose anything after a question mark. Personal information in quotes is masked structurally, which is not a guarantee: review before publishing.
